q1_issues.issue: The plural indefinite object 'large herds' is collapsed into a single herd witness, so the sentence's plurality of herds is lost and 'large' attaches to that one herd instead of distributing over the herds.

q2_gaps: nested plurality - a plural of collective groups ('herds of cows'), where each member of the outer group is itself a GroupOf, has no specified encoding
capitalized ethnonym used as a common-noun kind ('these Tuareg') - whether the proper-noun Name rule applies to a proper-noun-derived kind symbol is unaddressed
notes: Holder/Theme on 'have', the Past wrapper, and the demonstrative-plural group witness are all correct, and (Member sk_herd_1 large) is licensed as a size property of the collection itself. No per-member distribution rule is emitted for 'These Tuareg had ...', which is defensible if the possession is read collectively.
